item.name: Squirrel
item.unlockTiming: Default form every player spawns as before earning any Wins.
item.cardSummary: The free starting form. Every run begins as a Squirrel before you spend Wins on your first evolution.
item.notes: Base form. The fan wiki community ranking places it at C tier as the weakest, expected starter.

item.name: Chicken
item.unlockTiming: First evolution to buy; the fan wiki says to purchase it as soon as you can afford it.
item.cardSummary: The first and cheapest evolution. Buy it immediately after your earliest Wins to start compounding speed.
item.notes: Also referred to as Hen. Lowest Win cost in the chain and the strongest early return per the fan wiki.

item.name: Rabbit
item.unlockTiming: Aim to own it before settling into World 1 farming.
item.cardSummary: The third step in the chain and a World 1 farming form. You must own it before you can reach later forms.
item.notes: Required stepping stone; you cannot skip to later forms without buying Rabbit first.

item.name: Goose
item.unlockTiming: The fan wiki suggests owning it around the first rebirth (about rebirth 25).
item.cardSummary: A mid-chain bridge form. Its Win cost jumps noticeably over Rabbit, so it usually lands around your first rebirth.
item.notes: Cost rises sharply versus earlier forms per the fan wiki; treated as the bridge into World 2 prep.

item.name: Cat
item.unlockTiming: The fan wiki recommends buying it before entering World 2.
item.cardSummary: A World 2 workhorse form. The fan wiki advises owning it before you push into World 2.
item.notes: First A-tier community ranking and a substantial Win cost over Goose.

item.name: Fox
item.unlockTiming: Targeted during World 2 farming, typically with rebirth 25 or higher active.
item.cardSummary: The game's mascot form (it appears in the game's title). A costly late-chain evolution farmed in World 2.
item.notes: Featured in the game's Roblox title icon. Costs substantially more Wins than Cat per the fan wiki.

item.name: Deer
item.unlockTiming: The fan wiki frames it as a post-rebirth-50 purchase.
item.cardSummary: The highest verified evolution and the end of the confirmed chain. The fan wiki treats it as an endgame, post-rebirth purchase.
item.notes: Highest Win cost of the verified chain. The fan wiki marks it S tier and the last confirmed form; rumored forms beyond Deer are unconfirmed.

item.name: Ostrich
item.unlockTiming: Bought any time as a Roblox game pass; it sits outside the Wins evolution chain.
item.cardSummary: The cheapest gamepass animal form. An optional paid alternative that does not replace the Wins evolution chain.
item.notes: Confirmed and priced from the official Roblox game-pass API. Optional cosmetic/alternative form, not part of the required progression.

item.name: Alpha Wolf
item.unlockTiming: Bought any time as a Roblox game pass; it sits outside the Wins evolution chain.
item.cardSummary: A mid-priced gamepass animal form. Optional and outside the natural Wins chain.
item.notes: Confirmed and priced from the official Roblox game-pass API. Named by the fan wiki and GamelandInsider as a gamepass-exclusive form.

item.name: Alpha Raptor
item.unlockTiming: Bought any time as a Roblox game pass; it sits outside the Wins evolution chain.
item.cardSummary: A higher-priced gamepass animal form. Optional and outside the natural Wins chain.
item.notes: Confirmed and priced from the official Roblox game-pass API. Not mentioned by the fan wiki; sourced directly from the official pass list.

item.name: Alpha Trex
item.unlockTiming: Bought any time as a Roblox game pass; it sits outside the Wins evolution chain.
item.cardSummary: A premium gamepass animal form. Optional and outside the natural Wins chain.
item.notes: Confirmed and priced from the official Roblox game-pass API. Not mentioned by the fan wiki; sourced directly from the official pass list.

item.name: Alpha Dragon
item.unlockTiming: Bought any time as a Roblox game pass; it sits outside the Wins evolution chain.
item.cardSummary: The most expensive gamepass animal form. Optional and outside the natural Wins chain.
item.notes: Confirmed and priced from the official Roblox game-pass API. Not mentioned by the fan wiki; sourced directly from the official pass list.
